sponsors.name: AG Grid
sponsors.capability: AG Studio supports embedded grids, charts, custom widgets and an agent framework.
sponsors.role: Configuration comparisons and source-linked conflict widgets.
sponsors.boundary: The UI must display backend-checked results, not create payment authority.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: APIMatic
sponsors.capability: The PayPal Context Plugin supplies API/SDK context to coding tools.
sponsors.role: Build the PayPal adapter and record a concrete context-assisted integration example.
sponsors.boundary: Development assistance; not a runtime payment validator.
sponsors.access: PayPal plugin needs no separate APIMatic credentials; subscription offers have conditions.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Astropods
sponsors.capability: Deployable agent blueprints, tool integrations and observability; container HTTP/FastAPI is documented.
sponsors.role: Host the requirement/specification compiler with traces.
sponsors.boundary: Authenticated invocation and account resource/model limits need a live spike.
sponsors.access: Free account advertised; operational limits unverified.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Bryntum
sponsors.capability: Gantt dependencies and resource Scheduler/Calendar components.
sponsors.role: Editable delivery, assembly and setup dependencies.
sponsors.boundary: Backend domain logic remains authoritative for feasibility.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Channel3
sponsors.capability: Product discovery and enrichment with prices, offers, variants and retailer links.
sponsors.role: Find candidates and connect evidence to exact variants.
sponsors.boundary: No implied retailer payment authority; missing technical specifications stay unknown.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Elastic
sponsors.capability: Structured, text and vector search, including hybrid retrieval.
sponsors.role: Retrieve normalized specifications and original evidence passages.
sponsors.boundary: Search projections do not replace durable order state.
sponsors.access: 14-day cloud trial, further 30-day extension path; local option documented.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Kernel
sponsors.capability: Cloud browser sessions with live views and video recordings.
sponsors.role: Inspect permitted specification pages and retain evidence.
sponsors.boundary: Recorded video is not deterministic transaction replay or proof that a claim is true.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Postman
sponsors.capability: API design, testing, documentation and monitoring; PayPal collections are available.
sponsors.role: Export a configuration-linked payment lifecycle/regression collection.
sponsors.boundary: Use independent assertions; redact tokens and private data.
sponsors.access: Free starting plan; selected feature limits need checking.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Render
sponsors.capability: Web services, databases, workers and Python/TypeScript workflow tasks.
sponsors.role: Run domain/payment API, PostgreSQL and verification jobs.
sponsors.boundary: Automatic retries still require durable operation IDs and application idempotency.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed

sponsors.name: Zapier
sponsors.capability: MCP actions across connected applications with managed connections.
sponsors.role: Create an approved setup task after verified capture.
sponsors.boundary: Scope credentials and handle ambiguous action outcomes; do not grant arbitrary AI writes.
sponsors.access: 14-day Professional trial then Free; required action availability needs checking.
sponsors.status: Documented capability; proposed integration, not executed
